cases.title: Retain and retry a refused or unreachable save
preconditions: Capture contains article text; use a controlled refusal or offline condition. Guest mode should receive the sign-in remedy.
steps: Save while landing is refused or unreachable.
Inspect the Unsaved card, refusal sentence, and remedy.
Resolve the cause and retry; verify a repeated refusal leaves the item queued.
expected: The item remains visible and retryable on this device after failure; it leaves the queue only after confirmed landing. A guest is told to sign in.
Failed saves for equivalent canonical URLs keep one queued item with stable identity/creation time, incremented attempts, and newest capture payload.
Successful landing through any save path removes all queued entries for that canonical URL.

preconditions: Signed-in user with a device-selected organization and a controlled page whose article has distinguishable original text.

Edit the article markdown to contain a unique replacement sentence and Apply.
Save as a Source; inspect the landed reader-facing content and original capture.
expected: The Source content contains the edited sentence and excludes the replaced original sentence; the original capture stored with the Source retains the pre-edit article.
When the active page is queued, Retry is its only Save action and submits current panel edits made after the failed save; a repeat failure keeps those newest edits in one queue item.
Retry for a different queued page submits that queued page content rather than the active panel content.
cases.source_evidence: b8c8313 and d2b61d1 add the edited-text save path and real-extension acceptance assertions; no current runtime pass is recorded.

cases.title: Unsaved capture survives closing and reopening the panel

steps: Close the side panel after the failed save.

Inspect Unsaved captures and retry the item.
expected: The persisted queue item, its source URL and retry action are restored on mount; reopening does not clear it. A retry removes it only after confirmed landing.
After panel reopen the canonical URL has one retained retry item and no duplicate ordinary Save control.
cases.source_evidence: b8c8313 adds mount-time queue restoration and a close/reopen regression scenario; no current runtime pass is recorded.

cases.title: Saved-page lookup failure is not reported as unsaved

cases.remote_delta_acceptance: Already covers failed prior-save lookup; retain and extend to ensure the new notice is suppressed while lookup is unknown.

cases.title: Guest cannot open Tasks
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: In guest mode, inspect the tab strip and attempt to navigate to Tasks through any supported tab state restoration path.
expected: Tasks tab is absent and guest cannot render protected task queue.

cases.title: Queue search, project, grouping and sorting
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: As a signed-in member with a selected organization and at least two controlled queue rows, enter a distinctive search term; clear it. Select a project, switch grouping twice, and select another sort option. Reload Tasks.
expected: Search narrows and clear restores matching rows; project/group/sort selections affect visible ordering/grouping and remain consistent after reload.

cases.title: Nested queue filters and reset
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Open Filters. Select one available domain, status, category, and capture bucket in turn and record row counts; clear all filters. Repeat with an empty facet dataset.
expected: Each selection updates results/count; conditional facets appear only when source data supports them; clear restores unfiltered queue.

cases.title: Row selection and bulk action menu
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Select one auto-capturable row and one paste-only row. Open bulk resolve and choose each verdict against separate campaign-owned rows; exercise capture with mixed eligibility, then clear selection.
expected: Selection counts match selected rows; bulk capture only processes eligible sources and reports progress; each verdict updates only selected rows; clear removes selection.

cases.title: Single source open, capture, enrich, and verdict
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Open a controlled source URL and verify it opens separately. Run a normal capture; run a configured enrichment row; exercise awaiting_user Go on a gated fixture. For other rows open Resolve and choose each available verdict, including Retry only after an attempt. Copy URL.
expected: Open acts on the source URL; Run/Enrich starts the matching action; Go resumes user-held capture; each verdict updates that source and Retry visibility follows attempted-level state; copied URL matches row URL.

cases.title: Paste-only source submission
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Select a paste-only/L4 controlled queue row, enter unique non-secret text in its paste editor, submit, then refresh queue.
expected: Submitted content is acknowledged and associated with that source; refresh shows the resulting status or explicit actionable error.

cases.title: Parallel run session inspection and dismissal
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Create or observe a controlled parallel run. Expand a sub-run with output, one with an error, and one empty result; collapse and reopen the session; dismiss only after completion.
expected: Expanded rows show URL/output/error/data events as available; empty/running state is explicit; collapse preserves session; unfinished session cannot be mistaken for completed dismissal.

readiness_gaps: No runtime behavior verdict from source reading; execute role, organization, permission, error and persistence cases in the live side panel.

cases.title: Expand conversation and open in Chat
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: As a signed-in member with two controlled conversations, expand the first summary, note its plan/tasks/todos, collapse it, reopen, then choose Open in chat.
expected: Expanded detail belongs to selected conversation; collapse hides it; Open in chat selects same conversation and changes to Chat.

cases.title: Wipe confirmation and cancel/confirm
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: On a conversation with disposable plan/task/todo rows, click Wipe all and cancel; verify rows remain. Reopen, confirm, then refresh.
expected: Cancel preserves all rows; confirm removes that conversation’s plan, tasks and todos; dialog names permanent consequence.

cases.title: Task completion, edit, and removal
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: On controlled tasks, toggle a task through each available status, edit its title, remove a separate task, then clear completed/skipped tasks via confirmation.
expected: Status and edit persist on reload; removal affects only chosen task; clear removes completed/skipped rows only after confirmation.

cases.title: User todo lifecycle
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Enter a unique todo title and submit by button, add another with Enter, mark one done, reveal done group and confirm Clear done.
expected: Both todos appear under correct conversation; checkbox persists; done group reveals; confirmed clear removes done item and preserves open one.

cases.title: Task panel controls and empty conversation

cases.title: Create valid one-shot task and reload
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: As a member with selected organization open New task; enter unique title and prompt, choose one-shot, set a future time, choose ask mode and Chrome extension surface, then create and reload.
expected: Create is enabled for valid input; created task appears with chosen trigger/auth/surface and next due time after reload.

cases.title: Conditional schedule fields and validation
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Switch trigger through interval, heartbeat, cron and context-match; enter a valid schedule for each. Try a malformed cron and context-match with both conditions blank, then provide one condition.
expected: Only fields for selected trigger appear; invalid cron is visibly identified and creation is disabled; context-match requires at least one condition; valid config becomes eligible.

cases.title: Cancel and discard new task
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Open form, enter draft values, cancel, reopen the form.
expected: Form closes; reopening starts without the canceled draft and no record is created.

cases.title: Run, pause, and resume existing task
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: On a controlled ask-mode task trigger Run now and observe handoff to Chat; pause it, reload, then resume and reload.
expected: Run-now enters chat stream and refreshes row; paused task is disabled across reload; resumed task is enabled.

cases.title: Delete task confirmation and cascade
preconditions: Use the campaign PLAN.md resource/build receipt. For member/admin choose a device organization and record membership; for guest use a genuinely signed-out profile. Use campaign-owned controlled records.
steps: Choose a campaign-owned task with run history. Open delete confirmation, cancel and verify it remains; reopen and confirm, then refresh task list and inspect linked history availability.
expected: Cancel preserves task/history; confirm deletes task and linked trigger/run history as described by dialog.

cases.title: Task create carries selected organization or shows recovery remedy
preconditions: Use a disposable task and a principal belonging to two organizations.
steps: Set organization A on this device and create a task; inspect its organization and reload Agenda.
Clear the device organization or use a principal with no memberships and submit the form.
Restore an organization and retry from the retained form.
expected: The atomic RPC receives organization A and the created task persists in A.
A resolver refusal creates no task and displays a clear remedy while retaining the form.
A subsequent valid retry creates the task once.

cases.title: Guest extraction and sign-in save gate
preconditions: Signed-out profile; controlled ordinary webpage with two distinct repeated field values; no saved session.
steps: Open Data; enter picker; select two elements and exit; verify fields appear. Enter a pattern name and click save; then use sign-in action.
expected: Page field selection/extraction is reachable to guest; pattern save is withheld and directs to auth; no pattern is written before auth.

cases.title: Matched pattern run, copy variants, and retry
preconditions: Signed-in controlled domain with an owned saved pattern, known matching page, and network retry available.
steps: Open Data on matching URL and run the match; copy each displayed pattern representation, including admin-only JSON as admin; force/load an observable pattern error and press Retry.
expected: Rows correspond to the selected page; copy formats match selector/agent/JSON variants; retry either restores saved patterns or presents explicit error; role option visibility follows source.

cases.title: Manual field pattern lifecycle and extracted rows
preconditions: Signed-in member with selected device organization; controlled page and disposable pattern target.
steps: Pick two fields; name and save the pattern; reread saved-pattern list. Run it and copy TSV, JSON, and AI forms. Separately pick fields and cancel.
expected: Saved pattern contains chosen fields and organization; extraction output matches page values; each clipboard variant encodes those rows; cancel clears unsaved selection.

cases.title: Non-matching page and active-tab boundary
preconditions: Saved pattern belongs to controlled host A; active tab is controlled host B with different DOM.
steps: Open Data on B and ensure pattern A does not auto-match; run a saved pattern only if explicitly offered; navigate B to C during view and observe result clearing.
expected: No silent cross-host match; run failures identify no-match/error and do not show stale rows; navigation clears prior results.

cases.title: Guest cannot open Capture handoff queue
preconditions: Genuinely signed-out profile.
steps: Inspect tab strip and attempt to restore Capture as active tab.
expected: Capture is omitted for guest because its queue is org-scoped.

cases.title: Switch organization holding pending items
preconditions: Signed-in member who belongs to two organizations; other membership has a controlled waiting handoff.
steps: Open Capture with active organization A; use “waiting elsewhere” control to switch to organization B; wait for subscription refresh.
expected: Only a membership-listed organization can be selected; device org switches and queue refreshes; pointer clears after successful switch; membership loss yields explicit explanation.

cases.title: Run waiting queue and observe outcomes
preconditions: Signed-in member with controlled waiting item on safe test page; service/permission can be unavailable on a separate attempt.
steps: Run browser-safe batch; observe per-item phases and terminal result. Reopen offline/degraded subscription state.
expected: Progress and terminal success/refusal appear per item; degraded data identifies staleness and timed refresh; no silent successful state for refused action.

cases.title: Drive, capture, or skip one item

expected: Extension leaves page actions to user until explicit capture; capture completes and updates status; skip removes only selected handoff and records note; pickup opens matching item/tab.

cases.title: Reject stale credential offers after organization switch
preconditions: Signed-in principal belongs to two organizations; device active organization is explicitly set. Use an owned disposable sign-in form and fixture; capture page is open before switching.
steps: Trigger and observe a pending credential offer for the current organization.
Switch the device active organization while the offer is pending.
Observe the prior offer, then wait for any offer under the newly active organization.
Do not submit the website form; verify fields remain unchanged.
expected: Offer from the prior organization is invalidated and cannot be accepted or submitted after the switch.
Any new offer is resolved under the newly selected organization.
No credential is written and no website form is submitted during the check.

cases.title: Vault list can be freshly read after browser restart
preconditions: Signed-in principal with explicitly selected organization and controlled Vault fixture; browser lifecycle harness records the replacement extension worker and sidepanel.
steps: Open Vault and observe its list before restarting the browser.
Close the owned browser fully and start a replacement process against the same profile.
Reopen the extension sidepanel, navigate to Settings and then Vault after replacement binding.
Observe the Vault items request and response initiated by the replacement sidepanel.
expected: Replacement process and extension contexts are distinct from the original run.
A successful Vault list read occurs after replacement sidepanel binding, not only during startup.
Vault data is read without creating, editing, or deleting credential records.

cases.title: Distinguish failed site-login lookup from no matches and retry
steps: On a supported login page, force the browser-login match request to fail.
Confirm the error and Retry control appear and prior candidates are not actionable.
Restore service and retry.
expected: Failure is not shown as an empty successful result; candidates from an earlier page or actor are cleared; retry runs for the same current tab, page, and actor and then displays the returned result.
preconditions: Use a fresh build receipt including source75cfb09 or later; follow the campaign resource/build/reload contract. Use controlled owned fixtures and never expose credential values.
